name: Masonry gallery
summary: Pictures and cards of different heights packed into columns.
description:
Use it for photo walls, testimonial walls and mood boards, where items have different heights and the order does not matter much.

It is CSS multi-column: items keep their own height and never split across columns, and the column count follows the width (each column at least --v-masonry-col, default 16rem). Columns fill top to bottom, so when reading order matters use .v-grid instead.

classes.name: v-masonry
classes.description: The list. Each child is one item; images inside fill the column width.

states.description: The narrowest a column may get (default 16rem). --v-gap sets the space between items.

a11y: Columns read top to bottom, then the next column: fine for pictures, confusing for steps or ranked lists.
Give every image real alt text; the layout adds nothing for screen readers to skip.

examples.title: Photo wall
examples.description: Pictures of different shapes and a quote card.
